name: Tabetha's Farm
summary: In the Quagmire, Tabetha keeps her homestead apart from the marsh's dangers.

sections.title: A Hermit's Sanctuary
sections.body: In western Dustwallow Marsh, a weather-worn hut, garden plots, and a dock mark the farm. The dock opens onto the swamp's waterways, while the homestead lies far from the rivalries of Theramore and Brackenwall Village. Tabetha, a reclusive human sorceress, lives here in near-total seclusion. She studies arcane and fel power beyond the reach of Dalaran and local authorities.

sections.title: A Waypoint of Arcane Power
sections.body: Mages and warlocks travel from Kalimdor and the Eastern Kingdoms to seek Tabetha's aid. Mages come to master raw arcane surges. Warlocks ask her to help cleanse volatile artifacts such as the Orb of Orahil.

faq.answer: Tabetha, an eccentric mage, lives at the farm. She tends its garden, dock, and homestead amid the Quagmire's perilous swamp creatures.

faq.q: Why do mages travel all the way to this farm?
faq.answer: Mage trainers across the world send promising students to Tabetha to deepen their arcane knowledge. She knows volatile mana surges, ancient relics, and primal powers rarely taught in city academies.
Warlocks seek Tabetha's knowledge of exorcism and elemental energies to purify and tame dangerous artifacts. They seek her help with the rituals that cleanse the Orb of Orahil.

faq.q: Is Tabetha's Farm allied with the Horde or the Alliance?
faq.answer: Tabetha keeps a neutral stance and shares her wisdom with travelers of any allegiance. Her farm is independent of Jaina Proudmoore's Theramore and the Horde forces at Brackenwall Village.

angles.text: As a mage, your capital city trainers may send you to Tabetha's Farm. She can help you study volatile mana surges and ancient relics of power.
As a warlock, you can seek Tabetha's help to cleanse the potent energies bound to the Orb of Orahil.
